citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
**During a review of records it was noted that the last semi annual inspection conducted by the IACUC occurred in
December 2025. No documentation was available to provide evidence that the IACUC conducted an inspection of the
research facility's animal areas. Not conducting a inspection of the animal facilities on a semi annual basis does not allow
the IACUC to determine if the facility has been maintained in a manner to protect the welfare of the animals. It is the
responsibility of the IACUC to conduct semi annual inspections of the research facility's animal areas to ensure they are
maintained in a manner that protects the health and safety of the animals.
Correction date: From this date forward

citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
**A review of the active protocol indicated a search for alternatives had not been conducted by the principal investigator.
The protocol that was reviewed involved blood draws on hamsters. According to the principal investigator, anesthesia was
provided during the procedures due to the potential for distress to the animals, however, there was no documentation to
indicate a search for possible alternatives to the distressful procedures had been conducted. A written narrative
description of searches for alternatives to potentially painful and/or distressful procedures should be provided in the
protocol. A search for alternatives to painful and/or distressful procedures should be provided in the written protocol in
order for the IACUC to ensure that appropriate methods have been considered by the principal investigator in order to
determine alternatives were not available.
Correction date: August 20, 2026
No animals on site at the time of the inspection.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
